name: Valley Awakening
source:
Valley Awakening is an adult visual novel about thirteen women, a town that keeps its own schedule, and the slow business of becoming someone worth their time.
Two years ago your father walked out the door and never came back. Kate, his landlady, moved in instead of evicting you. Now you have a house, an empty week, and a town full of people who are not waiting for you. Days run on a real calendar. Everyone has a job, a routine, and somewhere they would rather you did not follow them to. Where things go with any of them depends on when you show up, what you say, and whether you were paying attention the last time. 
[from [url=https://wargnema.itch.io/valley-awakening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《溪谷觉醒》是一部成人向视觉小说，讲述十三位女性、一座按自身作息运转的小镇，以及一步步成长为值得她们倾注时间之人的慢热故事。
两年前，你的父亲推门离家，从此一去不回。他的女房东凯特非但没有把你赶走，反而搬了进来。如今你拥有了一栋房子、空空荡荡的一周日程，以及一整镇根本不会在原地等你的居民。日子遵循着真实的日历流转，每个人都有自己的工作、作息，以及不愿让你尾随涉足的去处。你与任何人之间的关系将走向何方，全看你在何时现身、说了什么话，以及上一次相处时有没有用心留意。
[摘自[url=https://wargnema.itch.io/valley-awakening]itch.io[/url]]
